acf_pacf.caption_plain: Shows how each value relates to its own past. Bars outside the dashed band are more than chance.

ccf.caption_plain: Shows the correlation of each driver with the KPI some periods later. A peak at lag 2 shows that the effect of the driver occurs two periods after the driver.

correlation.caption_plain: Shows how strongly the variables move together (1: together, -1: opposite).

distributions.caption_plain: How the values of each variable are spread out.

groups.caption_plain: Each variable compared across geo levels.

missingness.caption_plain: Shows where values are missing (a darker cell shows more missing values).

outliers.caption_plain: Shows the values that are more than 3.5 robust standard deviations from the typical value.

overview.caption_plain: What the dataset contains: its dimensions, variables and roles.
overview.summary_plain: 3 variables over 156 weeks x 3 geo x 2 channel, from 2022-01-02 to 2024-12-22. The result to explain is 'sales'. 1 data problem(s) to look at.

quality.caption_plain: Shows the data problems to look at before you fit a model. The most serious problems are first.

items.message_plain: 'price' has a gap of 7 periods in a row.
items.suggested_action: Examine the source. You cannot fill long gaps reliably.
Small gaps are usually not a problem. If the model needs complete data, impute them.

stationarity.caption_plain: Whether each series returns to a stable level (ADF and KPSS tests).

adf.null_plain: The series has a unit root (it moves away from a stable level and does not return).
adf.verdict_plain: The series returns to a stable level. You do not need its differences.

kpss.null_plain: The series is stationary (it changes around a stable level or trend).
kpss.verdict_plain: The series changes around a stable level. You do not need its differences.

rows.verdict_plain: The series varies around a stable level: no differencing needed.

warnings_plain: The view does not show 1 series (gaps or fewer than two seasons).

vif.caption_plain: Shows how much each driver overlaps with the other drivers. Above 10, it is difficult to separate their effects.
